properties.fullDescription: Orchard Lodge briefly comprises a stunning, high specification detached property which was built in 2022 by local and reputable builder, Andrew Wrest. The whole property is finished to exacting standards with a supreme attention to detail throughout. All the rooms are very well proportioned and feature high specification fixtures and fittings. Orchard Lodge has underfloor heating throughout the ground floor and is entered into a useful lobby which leads into the reception hall and open plan living space. The high-quality kitchen was sourced from County Kitchens, a local family run company which are based in Leyburn. It offers an excellent selection of units which are complemented by granite worktops. There is a wide range of integrated appliances including twin ovens, ceramic hob, dishwasher and an integrated full height larder fridge and an integrated full height freezer. There is also a large central island which makes the space great for entertaining and incorporates a breakfast bar. The living area surrounds a log burning stove set within a porceline tiled fireplace and it has bi-folding doors which open out allowing direct access to the private garden. Usefully, there is a separate utility room just off the kitchen area which offers excellent storage and is plumbed for a washing machine. Completing the ground floor is a bedroom which could be used as an office if required. This also has bi-fold doors out to the garden and has use of an ensuite wet room which is fully tiled with a walk-in shower, WC and hand basin. To the first floor there are two double bedrooms. The main bedroom has a selection of bespoke fitted wardrobes and shelving and a generous ensuite bathroom with a modern suite including a WC, hand basin, bath and a walk-in shower together with a built-in dresser offering storage. The second bedroom also has an ensuite with walk-in shower. Externally the property is complemented by a private garden which provides a suntrap in the summer months. This is paved and has planted borders with a mix of flowers and shrubs. There is also a delightful water feature. There is also driveway parking for 2 cars and a useful garden store. The property would make an ideal full-time home or quality holiday let in the heart of Leyburn. An early viewing is advised.
